name: Bloodbound
source:
You're applying for a job with brilliant CEO billionaire Adrian Raines... but there's more to him than it seems. Urban fantasy meets romance in this sexy vampire thriller.

[From [url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Bloodbound,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你去應徵一份工作，老闆是身價億萬的天才執行長亞德里安．雷恩斯，卻發現他遠比表面複雜。都市幻想與浪漫結合，講述一場性感的吸血鬼驚悚故事。

[來源：[url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Bloodbound,_Book_1]Choices Wikia[/url]]
